name: R Academy
source:
A story based in the player's decisions with more than 50 endings including 'bad end', 'fatal end' 'true end' and many more. The game has mostly 3 heroines, but is at least possible to get a route (at least 1) with any girl that appears.

R Academy doesn't have consistent story, as it changes with every decision, whether is immediate or at the end of the game. Basically an experience in acts.  
[From [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/779780/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
这是一个由玩家决定故事走向的游戏，拥有超过50个结局，包括“坏结局”“致命结局”“真结局”等。游戏主要有三名女主角，但玩家至少可以让每一位登场女孩进入一条路线。

《R学院》没有固定剧情，每次选择都会改变故事，无论是立即改变还是在游戏结尾改变。它本质上是一段由多个章节组成的体验。

[来源：[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/779780/]Steam[/url]]
